# Taste of Sonada
> A premium cafe and restaurant in Sonada, Darjeeling.

Taste of Sonada is a highly-rated cafe located in Chaikhola, near Green Hill School, Sonada, West Bengal 734209.
We serve Darjeeling tea, specialty coffee, burgers, fried chicken, and Tibetan cuisine.
Our average rating is 4.9 stars based on 135 reviews.
Price range is ₹200 to ₹400.
Open daily from 08:30 to 20:00.
